configure_mask_rcnn_caffe_fpn_ms_poly: configure a mask r-cnn model with resnet-50 caffe backbone, multi-scale training, and polygon masks for coco dataset
build_train_pipeline_coco: build a training pipeline that loads images, annotations with polygon masks, applies multi-scale resize and random flip for coco detection
setup_data_preprocessor_caffe: setup a data preprocessor with caffe-style normalization (mean=[103.53, 116.28, 123.675], std=[1,1,1], bgr_to_rgb=false)
configure_backbone_resnet50_caffe: configure a resnet-50 backbone with caffe style, frozen normalization, and pretrained detectron2 weights
configure_train_dataloader: configure a train dataloader with multi-scale random choice resize pipeline and polygon mask annotations for mask r-cnn
